item.tib: zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i snying po 'dzab kyi rim pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang / dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis/ lho rgyal mo tsha ba rong / ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
